title: acquire or mirror true forced-random B-stack pedestal ROOT for P04m support veto closure

follow_up_ticket.title: P04n3: acquire external DAQ run log or scaler metadata for B-stack trigger-code semantics
follow_up_ticket.body: Question: can external DAQ run logs or scaler metadata explain whether the mounted B-stack ROOT trigger code 1 exhausts all acquisition modes, or whether forced/random pedestal triggers were recorded outside data/root/root? Expected information gain: distinguishes true non-acquisition from mirror omission and determines the operational path for a direct P04m pedestal-veto validation.
